dict.string: Ask Eden controls your Mac's apps (Mail, Calendar, Notes, Finder) only when you ask it to, for example to draft an email or add an event.
Ask Eden listens only when you start dictation or a voice conversation with Eden.
Ask Eden reads your calendar when you ask about your schedule.
Ask Eden looks at your screen only when you ask it to, for example to help with what you are working on.
Ask Eden reads or saves files on your Desktop when you ask it to.
Ask Eden reads or saves files in Documents when you ask it to.
Ask Eden reads or saves files in Downloads when you ask it to.
Ask Eden uses the camera only when you start a video conversation.
